headings.usage: Use for all headlines. Do not center-align blindly; prefer left-alignment for B2B readability.

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, labels, and form inputs. Extremely legible for technical SaaS.

primary.usage: Hero background (if inverted), Footer background, structural headings, form focus states.

accent.usage: EXCLUSIVELY for CTA buttons, key checkmark icons, and critical conversion metrics. Do not overuse.

background.usage: Use base for main sections, secondary for alternating bands (like FAQ or Testimonials) to separate content without gradients.

colors.CRITICAL_RULE: ABSOLUTELY NO GRADIENTS. Use solid hex codes only. No linear-gradient or radial-gradient in CSS. Do not use opacity fades for backgrounds.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders (border-gray-200) around cards, sections, and grids to create the 'Technical Grid' structural look.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. Use flat solid offset shadows (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#1E3A5F]) for high-end Brutalist/SaaS feel, or very subtle structural shadows (shadow-sm). DO NOT use large soft drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-sm (4px) or rounded-md (6px) max. Do not use highly rounded pill shapes except for specific badges. Sharp, crisp edges represent precision SaaS.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Use gap-12 or gap-16 between grid items.
grids_and_layouts.hero: Split layout: 55% Left text (H1, Subhead, CTA, Trust Badges) / 45% Right image (Dashboard preview with a solid #1E3A5F offset block behind it).
grids_and_layouts.bento_features: Use 'High Density Grid' (Mode B from guidelines) for features. 3-column grid (md:grid-cols-3). Direct children of grid must use solid backgrounds with 1px borders.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Strict left-alignment for forms, text blocks, and bullet points. Center alignment is ONLY permitted for section overarching headlines.

components.buttons: Solid #F97316 background, #FFFFFF text, font-semibold. Hover state: bg-[#EA580C] and -translate-y-0.5. No gradient, no ring unless focused. data-testid required.
components.inputs: Shadcn standard but customized: h-12, border-gray-300, focus:border-[#1E3A5F] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#1E3A5F].
components.accordion: FAQ uses Shadcn Accordion. border-b only. No background color (transparent to white). text-[#1E3A5F] for questions.
components.dialog_exit_intent: Shadcn Dialog. Triggered dynamically via JS on mouseleave of window. Needs a bold hook ('Wait! See who is on your site right now...'), a 2-field form, and a large Orange CTA.
components.trust_badges: Place immediately below the Hero CTA and Form submit buttons. E.g., 'Secure PHP/MySQL Infrastructure' or 'Trusted by 1,000+ Businesses' with padlock icon.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle translation (-translate-y-[1px]) or border color shifts. DO NOT use opacity fades for interactive elements.
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Fade-in up for grid items using Framer Motion (y: 20, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1).
motion_and_interactions.forbidden: No continuous pulsing, no bouncy animations. Keep it professional and reliable.

images.description: graphs of performance analytics on a laptop screen
images.placement: Hero section right-side visual. Place inside a container with rounded-md and a solid #1E3A5F border or shadow offset.

images.description: a woman sitting at a desk using a laptop computer
images.placement: Target audience representation in the 'Problem/Solution' section or as a featured testimonial image.

images.description: Man smiling in modern office setting

sections: Header (Logo left, solid Orange CTA right. border-b. bg-white)
Hero (Split layout, H1 text-gray-900, Orange CTA, Trust badge underneath)
Social Proof (Grayscale client logos, massive spacing)
Problem/Solution (Bento grid, solid backgrounds, 1px borders. Emphasize 'Stop guessing who visits your site')
How It Works (3 clear steps, left-aligned, icons in Navy circles)
Final CTA (Solid Navy #1E3A5F background, White text, massive Orange CTA)

instructions_to_main_agent: YOU MUST NOT USE GRADIENTS. The user strictly forbid them. Ensure Tailwind classes like bg-gradient-to-r are absent.
Build the Exit Intent Popup using a customized Shadcn Dialog component. Trigger it by listening to the 'mouseleave' event on the document where e.clientY <= 0.
Implement the lead capture form with react-hook-form and zod for validation. Include Name, Email, Phone, Website.
Make the phone number a 'click-to-call' link (href='tel:...').
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons for Trust Badges.
Ensure all fonts are imported via Google Fonts (Chivo for headings, IBM Plex Sans for body) in index.css or index.html.
Do NOT center-align the main app wrapper. Preserve default left-alignment for text rhythm.
Always add `data-testid` attributes to interactive elements (CTAs, form inputs, accordion triggers).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create crisp, high-end B2B SaaS frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use split, bento, or asymmetric layouts.
Create depth through 1px borders and solid color offsets rather than blurry drop shadows for this specific app.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties like transition-colors.
NEVER use emojis for icons. Use proper icon libraries (Lucide React is installed).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states (transform, color).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using Shadcn UI components for complex interactions like Accordion and Dialog.
